heading: A family business built one door at a time
story:
Summit Garage Doors started with one truck, one toolbox and a simple idea: show up when you say you will, quote what the job actually costs, and do work you'd be proud to put your name on.

Fifteen years and thousands of doors later, that's still the whole playbook. We're a family-run company — not a national franchise — which means the person who quotes your job is often the same person who installs it, and every warranty is backed by someone you can actually call.

We live and work in the same neighborhoods we serve. Our customers are our neighbors, and our reputation rides on every driveway we leave.

values.title: Straight answers
values.text: Written quotes before work starts. If a repair doesn't make sense, we'll tell you — even when replacement would pay us more.

values.title: Craftsmanship
values.text: Doors leveled to the millimeter, springs balanced by feel and by gauge, and a safety test on every single job.

values.title: Respect for your home
values.text: Drop cloths down, old parts hauled away, driveway swept. You shouldn't be able to tell we were there — except for the door.
